svg.title: Diagram: a launch sentence decomposed into five evidence checks
svg.desc: A hand-drawn notebook diagram. On the left, a box labelled 'The launch sentence' contains 'fast + frontier + cheap + open'. Five arrows fan to a numbered checklist on the right: 1. Who ran the test (vendor, independent, platform, harness); 2. Instrument and version (62.8 and 72.5 are different benchmarks); 3. What the price excludes (promo end date, retries, cache, tools); 4. What the license says ('open' has conditions); 5. What live traffic shows (P50 today, not the headline).

text.tspan: how the October launches decompose into checks
promo end date, retries, cache, tools
Each layer supports a smaller claim than the sentence implies.
Labels from the October 2026 record — desk research, no model testing.
